fixit_policy: End the non-static loan before the suspension point or move/copy an independently owned value into the continuation frame; do not invent a lifetime extension.
message: A non-static loan remains live across a suspension point.
notes: FACET_BORROW_CROSSES_SUSPENSION has precedence for a borrowed Facet. This diagnostic covers every other stack, region, inout, exclusive, temporary-view, or callback loan that would survive suspension; product checker execution remains NOT_RUN.

fixit_policy: Reject the HIR/MIR artifact and rebuild its exact owner, admitted-loan, cleanup-token, retained-authority and place-disposition partitions from verified checker facts.
message: A continuation frame duplicates, loses, partially transfers, or invents a partition identity.
notes: Internal HIR/MIR release-verifier invariant; NOT_LIVE places never materialize frame slots, and retained actor authority is explicit. It is not a source-facing compiler diagnostic and product execution remains NOT_RUN.

fixit_policy: Reject the artifact and restore the closed frame/epoch transition table, including exactly one resume-or-cancel winner.
message: A continuation frame or suspension epoch uses an invalid transition.
notes: Internal HIR/MIR release-verifier invariant; terminal frames cannot resume and a committed epoch has one winner. Product execution remains NOT_RUN.

fixit_policy: Reject the artifact and reconstruct reverse-order, exactly-once cleanup from the verified cleanup-token plan.
message: A continuation-frame terminal path does not discharge cleanup exactly once in the required order.
notes: Internal HIR/MIR release-verifier invariant; cleanup continues after failure under the existing primary/suppressed failure law. Product execution remains NOT_RUN.

message: A continuation frame has an invalid managed-root rebind, descriptor, generation, or provenance binding.
notes: RootId identifies a storage location and is never transferred unchanged; destination roots are installed before receipt publication and source roots are then removed. Backend-private stack maps cannot infer or repair semantic roots. Product execution remains NOT_RUN.
